hero.title:
Zero Double-Bookings.
Guaranteed.
hero.description: Customers pick a slot, the system locks it atomically, creates the order, upserts the CRM contact, and notifies your team — all in one transaction.

body: PostgreSQL advisory locks prevent double-booking even under extreme concurrent load. If two people click the same slot at the same millisecond, one wins — the other sees 'slot taken' instantly. When a booking is confirmed, HABOS atomically creates or links a CRM client, generates an order with line items, deducts stock, and notifies the assigned team member. Cancel? Inventory restores and the order updates. Single transaction, no webhook delays, no orphaned records.
advisoryLock: PostgreSQL advisory locks prevent double-booking even under extreme concurrent load. If two people click the same slot at the same millisecond, one wins — the other sees "slot taken" instantly.

bookOrder.title: Book → order → CRM
bookOrder.body: One booking creates everything: order with line items, CRM contact upsert, staff notification, and customer confirmation email. Zero manual steps.

stock.title: Smart stock reservation
stock.body: Inventory tracked across pending → confirmed → completed flow. No overselling, no manual stock checks.

api.title: Public + internal APIs
api.body: Staff book from the dashboard. Customers book from your website or scheduling links. Same atomic protection, same availability pool.

beforeAfter.withoutText: Customer emails to book. You check your calendar. Reply with available times. They pick one. You create the appointment, the invoice, and add them to your contacts. 8 steps, 3 apps.
beforeAfter.withText: Customer picks a slot on your website. Done. Order, CRM entry, notification, and confirmation email happen automatically.

closing.title:
Other booking tools are a separate calendar.
HABOS bookings are wired into your entire business.
